shown.message:
I approved `paper-repo`#9 at head `bb51657`. The PDF built from that commit has no open `must` findings.

- **Consistency:** the abstract and the introduction now both say the label saving is at most 1.1%.
- **Internal labels:** "A6", "B5" and "C1" no longer appear in the paper. The Table 1 caption now defines P and U, and Fig. 2 has no title inside the graphic.
- **Validity-rule sensitivity:** the new sentence says that replacing the Wilson test with coverage ≥ 0.94 changes no class at the reference n, and changes the baseline or its validity in 2 of the 9 datasets. That matches `results/validity_sensitivity.csv` for those datasets.

I added the re-review to `reviews/v1-pr9-7ef2dac.md` in my repository and pushed it.
